frames.title: Bundle & Save Offer Overview and Examples
frames.on_screen:
Slide header: Bundle & Save (Highly Recommend Offer)
Body text: Group commonly purchased products and bundle together at a discount. Provide a REASON for the bundle & think of a name for the bundle as well.
1. "The Staple 6-Pack" | Regular $265 Now for $186.00
2. "Rat Protection Bundle" | Rat Vac + Capz + Vent + eBook | Regular $371 now $249
Visuals: Product offer page screenshots for "Complete Rat Vac Bundle" and "The Staple 6-Pack". Footer: Easy A Media.
